evals.prompt: Over the next few months I want to turn this CLI into a desktop app with sync. Make a roadmap.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the repository to describe the current state, asks about success criteria, horizon and constraints, and writes a roadmap folder with 3-7 observable milestones, a Derived plans table with what each plan resolves and its dependencies, and an ordering rationale. It creates no derived plan folders.
expectations: Creates the folder with plans.py new --type roadmap
Milestones are observable states with exit criteria
Derived plans table lists what each plan resolves, its milestone and dependencies
Contains no task-level detail or file paths to modify
Does not create derived plan folders or start make-plan
Ends by explaining that derived plans are created on demand with make-plan
